# Whole Dog Journal

> > Whole Dog Journal is a comprehensive resource for dog health, nutrition, training, and care with interactive tools, expert articles, and subscription-based access to in-depth guides.

Whole Dog Journal provides evidence-based information on dog wellness, behavior, and nutrition through articles, product reviews, and a dog food finder tool. The site serves both casual pet owners and those seeking detailed health guidance, with subscription access to archives and online learning resources.

## Core Tools & Shopping

- [Home - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com): Homepage featuring dog health, training, food reviews, and care articles.
- [Dog Food Finder - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/dog-food-search): Interactive dog food comparison and search tool with ingredient and price filtering.
- [Products - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/products): Product catalog featuring dog food, health, training, and wellness items.
- [Checkout Page - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/order/whole-dog-journal-subscription): Subscription purchase and checkout page with secure SSL payment processing.
- [Give a Gift - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/landing/give-a-gift): Gift subscription purchase page for dog health and training content.

## Dog Health & Nutrition Guides

- [What You Need to Know About Turmeric for Dogs](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/health/turmeric-for-dogs): Guide to turmeric and curcumin supplementation for dog arthritis and health.
- [Can Dogs Eat Salt? Understanding Sodium and Safety](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/health/can-dogs-eat-salt): Educational guide on sodium toxicity and safe salt levels for dogs.
- [Most Dog Liver Shunts Are Congenital](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/health/liver-shunts-in-dogs): In-depth article on congenital liver shunts in dogs and surgical correction.
- [Licorice Root for Dogs: Soothing and Healing](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/care/licorice-root-soothes-and-heals-dogs): Guide to licorice root herbal remedy benefits and side effects for dogs.
- [Apple Cider Vinegar for Dogs - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/care/non_traditional_healing/apple-cider-vinegar-for-dogs): Guide to apple cider vinegar uses for dog health and natural remedies.

## Dog Care & Training

- [How to Clean Dog Ears at Home - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/care/how-to-clean-dog-ears-at-home): How-to guide for cleaning dog ears with recommended products and methods.
- [DIY Dog First Aid Kit - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/care/12-items-to-include-in-your-diy-dog-first-aid-kit): Guide to assembling a DIY dog first aid kit with essential supplies.
- [The Best Cognitive Dog Toys - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/care/dog-toys/the-best-cognitive-dog-toys): Guide to cognitive dog toys for mental stimulation and enrichment.

## Dog Behavior & Lifestyle

- [Why Does My Dog Stare at Me? - Whole Dog Journal](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/behavior/why-does-my-dog-stare-at-me): Article explaining dog staring behavior and communication meanings.
- [Why Does My Dog Put Their Paw On Me?](https://www.whole-dog-journal.com/behavior/why-does-my-dog-put-their-paw-on-me): Article explaining dog paw behavior and communication methods.
